comment: Documentary shot plan v4 - LEGEND CARDS ARE THE STAR. Zero generic player footage (library clips were generic characters, not likenesses). Real app card artwork (194 available) is used: hero CardShowcase for Castro/Escobar/Carbajal/Milla (each card IS that person), CardWall collection moments (100+ LEGEND CARDS), and a PhoneMock ending showing worldcup26.world with a live card/news feed - the app is the payoff. CardDrift runs behind every typography beat so no frame is a flat text slate. TrophyCup replaces the old dome shape. Music: Kevin MacLeod CC-BY 4.0.

music.comment: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0 - credit required in description. Emotional arc: warm/hopeful (build+thanks) -> driving/epic (money+records) -> reverent/cinematic (greatest+Messi) -> triumphant (close).

sfx.comment: ElevenLabs sound-design hits at transitions and number-card reveals (whoosh into cards, stamp on big figures, braam on chapter turns).
